insights.one_liner: Big Four audit, tax and consulting firm with most Dutch openings in Amsterdam, including internships; nearly all its roles here don't need Dutch.

culture.text: One of the Big Four, doing audit, tax, consulting and deal advice; around 298,000 people worldwide.
Most staff have accounting and finance backgrounds.
7 of its 8 open jobs here are in Amsterdam, mostly IT, cloud and security, with 3 internships.

open.text: 7 of its 8 open jobs here (88%) don't ask for Dutch.
Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor under these names.

growth.text: Grew from about 250,930 staff in 2018 to 295,371 in 2021, with $45.1 billion revenue in 2021.
PwC revenues fell for the first time in more than a decade.

worth_knowing.text: PwC refused to sign off Japanese firm Nidec's accounts despite a $4bn charge.
